name: Tankdramon
main_effect: [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play 1 Digimon card with the [D-Brigade] trait and a play cost of 5 or less among them without paying the cost. Trash the rest.
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your Digimon with the [D-Brigade] trait attacks, reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. You may play 1 [Commandramon] among them without paying the cost. Trash the rest.
